pattern: にも関わらず（にもかかわらず）
purpose: Contrast a real circumstance with an unexpected result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / N / な-adjective + にもかかわらず
Despite the rain, many people gathered.
Despite being a beginner, she played beautifully.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + にもかかわらず
restrictions: Often includes である after nouns and な-adjectives.
mistake: Do not confuse with にかかわらず, “regardless of”.
